cursor.standing: PROVED — THE CROSSING IS NO LONGER SILENT, and the homonym is gone. Second disposition of troubles/silent-devices-2026-07-27.json, resolved by Akien's ruling 2026-07-27 ('why is the obvious answer of it should use the same logging as everything else not assumed to be the case?'): the common discipline is the DEFAULT; the audit trail never answered for the device surface because they are Law 7's two kinds — the audit record is a record of truth (command, returncode, full stdout/stderr), self.emit is a diagnostic breadcrumb. request_root now leaves one breadcrumb per round-trip (after it lands; pointer=audit id, values={returncode}); state()/settings() emit nothing. The module-level audit writer, named 'emit' since birth, is renamed write_audit — the homonym that let this component pass the first silent_device sweep no longer shares a name with the discipline. New tooth round-trips request_root through a real one-iteration daemon thread and pins exactly-one held breadcrumb. 9/9 green, netns-sealed (first validation file); CLEAN under the build gate — measured, not asserted.

window.standing: Born as a 'thing-for-akien-along-the-way' — a Cairn-native, Form-v0 replacement for the UU-tree sudoer stopgap so CC can self-serve root through an audited daemon.
Same-session correction: the first cut's 30-min idle timeout (CC over-add) was removed as misaligned with 'log in once a day' — idle is now opt-in, leaving the 24h cap as the sole automatic release.

PROVED for the minimal stone — all green without root (in-process and cross-process), record permanent and complete, retention cycles after a month, temporary is physics, window visible and honest; dogfooded under the tester with a falsification tooth confirmed to bite.
